propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' must detect layer-cake decompositions where children are partitioned by architectural layer rather than vertical slices
The criterion must detect consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces but lacks an ordering dependency

The criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA in pass1.py, and routed in criteria_routing.json with facet:container and default_posture:advisory
The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria via pass1_container when a fixture carries a children: list, enabling bounded sanity evaluation without batch corpus

Blocking promotion of decomp-shape is deferred until E6 order-stability (currently fleiss_kappa=0.55) clears the 0.6 floor AND criterion effectiveness metrics (detection_proxy, blocking_fp_proxy) meet dogfood standards
Bounded sanity evaluation with 4 hand-authored fixtures must demonstrate recall=1.0 on layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives and false-accept=0.0 on vertical-slice and ordered negatives
